#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Round 5: exact normalization of URIs, tags and header values in the wire."""
import json, subprocess, sys

CTX = {
    "directory": {"sip:ember@studio.test": ["sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121"],
                  "sip:desk@sales.test": ["tel:+12025550122"]},
    "accounts": {"s": {"primary": "sip:ember@studio.test", "allow": ["sip:desk@sales.test"]}},
    "gateways": {"g": {"local_domains": ["studio.test", "sales.test"], "peers": {}}},
}
LOCAL = {"kind": "local", "subject": "s"}

def run(raw):
    batch = dict(CTX); batch["jobs"] = [{"gateway": "g", "ingress": LOCAL, "trusted_out": True, "raw": raw}]
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],
                          input=json.dumps(batch).encode(), capture_output=True)
    assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr[-2000:]
    return json.loads(proc.stdout)["results"][0]

def mk(ruri="sip:inbox@relay.test", frm="From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7",
       to="To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>", ctype=None, body="hi"):
    hs = [frm, to, "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"]
    if ctype:
        hs.append("Content-Type: " + ctype)
    return ("%s %s SIP/2.0\r\n" % ("MESSAGE", ruri) + "".join(h + "\r\n" for h in hs)
            + "Content-Length: %d\r\n\r\n%s" % (len(body), body))

fails = []
def wcheck(name, raw, expect_wire_lines):
    got = run(raw)
    if got.get("status") != "accept":
        fails.append(name); print("FAIL %s -> %s" % (name, json.dumps(got))); return
    lines = got["wire"].split("\r\n")
    exp = list(expect_wire_lines)
    if lines[:len(exp)] != exp:
        fails.append(name)
        print("FAIL %s\n  got %s\n  exp %s" % (name, json.dumps(lines[:len(exp)]), json.dumps(exp)))

wcheck("ruri-normal", mk(), ["MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0"])
wcheck("ruri-escapes", mk(ruri="SIP:%69n%62ox@RELAY.TEST."),
       ["MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0"])
wcheck("ruri-trailingdot", mk(ruri="sip:inbox@relay.test."),
       ["MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0"])
wcheck("ruri-upper-host", mk(ruri="sip:inbox@RELAY.test"),
       ["MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0"])
wcheck("ruri-anon", mk(ruri="sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"),
       ["MESSAGE sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid SIP/2.0"])

wcheck("from-normal", mk(), ["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7"])
wcheck("from-escape", mk(frm="From: <SIP:%65mber@STUDIO.TEST>;tag=q7"),
       ["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7"])
wcheck("from-no-tag", mk(frm="From: <sip:ember@studio.test>"), ["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>"])
wcheck("from-tag-preserved", mk(frm="From: <sip:e1@alias.studio.test>;tag=Ab_9+.~-"),
       ["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=Ab_9+.~-"])
wcheck("from-display-dropped", mk(frm='From: "D, x" <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7'),
       ["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7"])
wcheck("from-bare", mk(frm="From: sip:ember@studio.test"), ["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>"])

wcheck("to-normal", mk(), ["To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>"])
wcheck("to-tel", mk(to="To: <tel:+12025550121>"), ["To: <tel:+12025550121>"])
wcheck("to-tel-upper", mk(to="To: <TEL:+12025550121>"), ["To: <tel:+12025550121>"])
wcheck("to-tag", mk(to="To: Bob <sip:inbox@relay.test>;tag=zz"), ["To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>;tag=zz"])
wcheck("to-lex-only", mk(to="To: <sip:nobody@nowhere.test>;tag=1"), ["To: <sip:nobody@nowhere.test>;tag=1"])
wcheck("to-anon", mk(to="To: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>"), ["To: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>"])

wcheck("callid", mk(), ["Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE", "Privacy: none",
                        "P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>",
                        "Content-Length: 2"])
wcheck("ctype-none", mk(), ["Privacy: none", "P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>",
                            "Content-Length: 2"])
wcheck("ctype-kept", mk(ctype="text/plain\t;charset=\"x\""),
       ["Content-Type: text/plain\t;charset=\"x\"", "Content-Length: 2"])

# CSeq / method
r = run(mk().replace("CSeq: 9 MESSAGE", "CSeq: 0000000009 MESSAGE"))
print("cseq:", r["wire"].split("\r\n")[4] if r["status"] == "accept" else r)
r = run(mk().replace("MESSAGE", "INVITE").replace("CSeq: 9 INVITE", "CSeq: 9 INVITE"))
print("invite:", r["wire"].split("\r\n")[0] if r["status"] == "accept" else r)

# body preservation
r = run(mk(body="a\r\nb\r\n\r\nc"))
print("body tail:", json.dumps(r["wire"][-20:]) if r["status"] == "accept" else r)

# long header value within limits
long_val = "v" * 20000
raw = ("MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\nX-Long: " + long_val +
       "\r\nFrom: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\nTo: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\nCall-ID: c\r\n"
       "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\n\r\nhi")
r = run(raw)
print("long header value:", r["status"], "wire-len", len(r.get("wire", "")))

# many leading zeros on content-length
raw = mk().replace("Content-Length: 2", "Content-Length: " + "0" * 2000 + "2")
r = run(raw)
print("cl zeros:", r["status"], r["wire"].split("\r\n")[-1] if r["status"] == "accept" else "")

print("%d failures" % len(fails))
PYEOF
